assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The service is documented in the clinical indication note
Mobile cardiac telemetry is CPT code 93229
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic episodes in the context of the patient's paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and prior transient ischemic attack
